name: pr-20261013-source-preservation
command:
import hashlib, json, os, subprocess, uuid
root = "/Users/huaodong/workspace/web-studio-lab"
def git(cwd, *args, env=None, input=None, timeout=12):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "--no-optional-locks", "-C", cwd, *args], input=input, capture_output=True, check=True, env=env, timeout=timeout).stdout
expected = {
"agent/edu-source-20261012": "be3a9f66cf1d02c934650de00dd3af64e20a5971",
"agent/edu-web-20261012": "ea3bad9e6602ccec3484cc55b247bae5815975b4",
"agent/status-surface": "1bce260678c5d60e6889a093e0c523c333019fca",
"codex/app-control-plane": "ea3bad9e6602ccec3484cc55b247bae5815975b4",
"codex/c1-development-20261010": "ea3bad9e6602ccec3484cc55b247bae5815975b4",
"codex/checkpoint-architecture-20261007": "0318a622e1f83c8bfd42c0d0962e06be5f9701eb",
"codex/checkpoint-guestbrowser-20261007": "8a7f9d981cc550507a29cc2a6734ea0249217b38",
"codex/competition-installer": "d792ee53fbe24bd144f2d9df65a1cce95a3ebf47",
"codex/consolidate-review-20261011": "917f3755865c5c90e1d1bcee73bc1dfa8ebbebe4",
"codex/integrate-lab-checkpoints-20261007": "4ab5581b611cff88629160dd1f598d1f7d550b74",
"codex/integrated-app-installer-20261009": "5c4edb7ef72f3c9e946e791f4fb9545fa27fad1d",
"codex/minimal-app-loop-20261009": "5c95c0750fe5acc165e70671590b3c690224dd8a",
"codex/release-smoke-fix-20261009": "cf62dc74f49e7f9e81598be7b9e5109cf5946e9c",
"codex/signing-diagnostics-20261009": "fb71ab7795a95aad3ce9b20a3b2581a857298645",
"codex/space-app-model": "cf62dc74f49e7f9e81598be7b9e5109cf5946e9c",
"codex/space-remake-integration-20261008": "b1e4f432f150526c5d117dfd929b47c8fb49cb7d",
"codex/unified-observation": "4ab5581b611cff88629160dd1f598d1f7d550b74",
"codex/unified-observation-delivery": "4ab5581b611cff88629160dd1f598d1f7d550b74",
"docs/dev-conventions": "643c1e2baedbc0129c21404665de8ff69c69b472",
"main": "536f0a1948e522a09310aa20784ec512476dc7be"
}
for branch, commit in expected.items():
    assert git(root, "rev-parse", "refs/heads/" + branch).decode().strip() == commit, branch
print("Original branch refs unchanged:", len(expected), flush=True)
inventory = json.loads(git(root, "show", "917f375:docs/acceptance/consolidation-20261011/source-inventory.json"))
for source in inventory["sources"]:
    result = {}
    for name, args in [("status.z", ["status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z", "--untracked-files=all"]), ("staged.patch", ["diff", "--cached", "--binary", "--no-ext-diff"]), ("unstaged.patch", ["diff", "--binary", "--no-ext-diff"])]:
        try:
            data = git(source["source_path"], *args)
            result[name] = "same" if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == source["artifacts"][name]["sha256"] else "different"
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            result[name] = "undetermined: timeout 12s"
    print(source["id"], json.dumps(result), flush=True)
for source, selection, frozen in [
    ("/Users/huaodong/workspace/_worktrees/status-surface-20261011", "repairs", "e1bc2f49b09f2411c0501b2491d193f09b63a91f"),
    (root, "wiki", "be74c9936932e14c2c8db9bcfe281501222513fb")
]:
    if selection == "repairs":
        paths = [p for p in git(source, "diff", "--name-only", "-z", "HEAD").split(b"\0") if p]
        added = [p for p in git(source, "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "-z").split(b"\0") if p]
        assert all(p.startswith(b"docs/acceptance/status-surface-20261011/repair-validation/") for p in added)
        paths += added
    else:
        paths = [p for p in git(source, "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "-z", "--", "docs/design/2026-10-12-code-wiki").split(b"\0") if p]
    env = dict(os.environ, GIT_INDEX_FILE="/private/tmp/wsl-pr-preservation-" + uuid.uuid4().hex + ".index")
    git(source, "read-tree", "HEAD", env=env)
    git(source, "add", "--pathspec-from-file=-", "--pathspec-file-nul", env=env, input=b"\0".join(paths) + b"\0")
    current = git(source, "write-tree", env=env).decode().strip()
    assert current == frozen, (selection, current, frozen)
    print("Imported original snapshot unchanged:", selection, len(paths), current, flush=True)
print("Original source indexes, branches and imported snapshots preserved; Documents physical status/diff remains undetermined.")
